pairings.nmcName: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bibinagar
pairings.evidence: AIIMS is the expansion of the acronym; NMC address 'All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bibinagar, Telangana'. Same institution, same town (Bibinagar).

pairings.ourName: Arundathi Institute of Medical Sciences, Hyderabad
pairings.evidence: Identical name; NMC address '48, Dundigal, Medchal Hyderabad, Telangana' matches our city Hyderabad. Only one Arundathi IMS in the NMC Telangana list.

pairings.nmcName: Ayaan Institute of Medical Sciences, Teaching Hospital & Research Centre, Kanaka Mamidi, R.R. Dist
pairings.evidence: NMC name is our name plus the hospital suffix and locality. Unique 'Ayaan' MBBS college in Telangana.

NMC address 'Yenkapally (V), Moinabad (M), CBIT (Post), R.R. Dist' - Yenkapally village is in Moinabad mandal, so our 'Moinabad' and NMC's 'Yenkapally' are the same campus. Only one Bhaskar Medical College.

pairings.ourName: CMR Institute of Medical Sciences, Medchal, Hyderabad
pairings.evidence: Identical name; NMC address '33, Kandlakoya (V), Medchal Malkajgiri, Hyderabad' matches our Medchal/Hyderabad locality.

pairings.ourName: Dr Patnam Mahender Reddy Institute of Medical Sciences, Chevella
pairings.nmcName: Dr. Patnam Mahender Reddy Institute of Medical Sciences, Chevella, Rangareddy
pairings.evidence: Same name (punctuation drift only) and same town Chevella; NMC address 'Chevella Village and Mandal Rangareddy (Dist.)'.

pairings.ourName: Dr VRK Women's Medical College, Hyderabad
pairings.nmcName: Dr. VRK Womens Medical College, Aziznagar
pairings.evidence: Apostrophe/period drift only; NMC address 'Aziz Nagar (Village), Ranga Reddy District, 500075' - Aziznagar is in Hyderabad's R.R. district periphery. Unique 'VRK' women's MBBS college.

pairings.nmcName: Employees State Insurance Coporation Medical College, Sanath Nagar, Hyderabad
pairings.evidence: ESIC = Employees State Insurance Corporation (NMC row has a typo 'Coporation'); identical locality Sanathnagar, Hyderabad.

pairings.ourName: Mahavir Institute of Medical Sciences, Vikarabad
pairings.nmcName: Mahavir Institute of Medical Sciences, Vikarabad, Telengana
pairings.evidence: Same name; NMC row only appends a (misspelt) state. NMC address '#2-4-40, Shivareddypet, Vikarabad, Vikarabad District' confirms our city Vikarabad.

pairings.nmcName: Maheshwara Medical College, Chitkul, Patancheru, Medak
pairings.evidence: Same name; NMC address 'Chitkul (V), Insapur Crossing Road, Patancheru (M), Medak' contains our locality Patancheru. Distinct from 'Government Medical College, Medak' (different institution, rule 4).

pairings.ourName: MediCiti Institute of Medical Sciences, Medchal
pairings.nmcName: Mediciti Institute Of Medical Sciences, Ghanpur
pairings.evidence: Same name (casing drift); NMC address 'Medchal (Mandal), Medchal Malkajgiri District-501401' - the Ghanpur campus lies in Medchal mandal. Only one MediCiti IMS in Telangana.

pairings.ourName: Neelima Institute of Medical Sciences, Ghatkesar
pairings.nmcName: Neelima Institute of Medical Sciences, Medchal
pairings.evidence: Identical name; NMC address 'Venkatapur (Village), Jodimetla Cross Road, Medchal-Malkjigiri (District)' - Venkatapur/Jodimetla is the Ghatkesar area, and the NMC affiliation 'Anurag University' is the Venkatapur (Ghatkesar) university. Single Neelima IMS in the state.

pairings.ourName: Prathima Relief Institute of Medical Sciences, Warangal
pairings.nmcName: Prathima Relief Institue of Medical Sciences
pairings.evidence: NMC row has a typo ('Institue'); its address '51-3-630 Sahasra Nagar, Hanamkonda Warangal Telangana' matches our city Warangal. NOT the same as 'Prathima Institute Of Medical Sciences, Karimnagar', which is a separate NMC row already matched.

pairings.ourName: RVM Institute of Medical Sciences and Research Centre, Medak
pairings.nmcName: R.V.M. Institute of Medical Sciences and Research Centre, Siddipet
pairings.evidence: Same name (dot drift); NMC address 'Medak, H.No. 2-51/1, Village Laxmakkapally, Mandal Mulugu, Siddipet Distt, Medak 502279' explicitly carries both Medak and Siddipet. Unique RVM IMS.

pairings.nmcName: S V S Medical College, Mehboobnagar
pairings.evidence: Spacing drift in acronym plus alternate transliteration of Mahabubnagar/Mehboobnagar; NMC address 'SVS Medical College, Mehboobnagar, Yenugonda 509001'. Distinct from 'Government Medical College, Mahabubnagar' (rule 4).

pairings.ourName: Shadan Institute of Medical Sciences, Hyderabad
pairings.nmcName: Shadan Institute of Medical Sciences,Research Centre and Teaching Hospital, Peerancheru
pairings.evidence: Same name; NMC row appends the hospital and locality Peerancheru (Himayathsagar Road, Hyderabad). MBBS on both sides - not the Shadan dental college.
